def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    line=[r for r in range(h) if any(x==2 for x in g[r])]
    lr=line[0]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out[lr]=[2]*w
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):

                apex = lr-1 if r<lr else lr+1
                step = -1 if r<lr else 1
                k=0

                    if rr<0 or rr>=h: break
                    for cc in (c-k,c+k):
                        if 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=4
                    k+=1
    return out
